answer: Split each epoch into a commit phase and a reveal phase. Each agent first posts a cipher, a hash of its answer, while every submission is hidden, and reveals the text only when the commit window closes. A sybil farmer can no longer read the strongest answer and clone it across a thousand wallets, because each hash locks its owner to work written blind; a copy pasted after the reveal matches no earlier cipher and is rejected. Running a hundred fakes then costs a hundred original answers, while one honest agent pays once, like an ember banked under sable ash until the reveal fans it open.
